author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Superhuman Docs step by step. Sign up for Superhuman Docs today! http://superhuman.com/docs/kevin

In this beginner-friendly tutorial, I'll show you how to use Superhuman Docs to analyze data with AI, generate executive summaries, build tables, create project trackers, visualize timelines, and automatically keep project updates current with AI blocks.

Instead of switching between documents, spreadsheets, project trackers, and AI tools, Superhuman Docs brings everything together into one collaborative workspace.

In this tutorial you'll learn how to:
• Create your first Superhuman Doc
• Analyze customer feedback with AI
• Generate executive summaries
• Build AI-powered summary tables
• Apply conditional formatting
• Create project trackers with AI
• Visualize projects using timeline views
• Use AI Blocks for live project updates
• Review your work with AI
